scripts.build: npm run build:inzDateSelect && npm run build:inzVrGenerate && npm run build:inzRecords && npm run build:inzLightbox
scripts.build:inzDateSelect: tsc -p inzDateSelect && sass --no-source-map inzDateSelect/src/inzDateSelect.scss inzDateSelect/dist/inzDateSelect/inzDateSelect.css && cpx "inzDateSelect/src/*.yml" inzDateSelect/dist/inzDateSelect && cpx "inzDateSelect/src/manifest" inzDateSelect/dist/inzDateSelect
scripts.build:inzVrGenerate: tsc -p inzVrGenerate && cpx "inzVrGenerate/src/*.py" inzVrGenerate/dist/inzVrGenerate && cpx "inzVrGenerate/src/*.yml" inzVrGenerate/dist/inzVrGenerate && cpx "inzVrGenerate/src/manifest" inzVrGenerate/dist/inzVrGenerate
scripts.build:inzRecords: tsc -p inzRecords && cpx "inzRecords/src/*.{py,yml,css}" inzRecords/dist/inzRecords && cpx "inzRecords/src/manifest" inzRecords/dist/inzRecords
scripts.build:inzLightbox: tsc -p inzLightbox && sass --no-source-map inzLightbox/src/inzLightbox.scss inzLightbox/dist/inzLightbox/inzLightbox.css && cpx "inzLightbox/src/*.yml" inzLightbox/dist/inzLightbox && cpx "inzLightbox/src/manifest" inzLightbox/dist/inzLightbox
